rachats.citation: Deutsche Borse has announced its acquisition of Axioma Inc. which was combined with STOXX and DAX to form Qontigo

Deutsche Borse agreed to buy Danish investment management software firm SimCorp for 3.9 billion
Deutsche Borse announced the acquisition of the Luxembourg-based distributed ledger technology company, FundsDLT
